title: Chapter 88 Time Travel
content:
Chapter 88 Time Travel

"You,"

Seeing Kong Wen's expression, Jiang Bei smiled slightly.

"Yes, I am Jiang Bei, the God of War in the Wuling Star Region."

Hearing this, Kong Wen was stunned.

But in a moment, he regained his composure.

With Yu Qingfeng's talent as a son of heaven, it is reasonable to meet a being like the God of War.

However, this God of War seems to be more terrifying than the rumors.

Is this aura really the Lord of Gods?

Kong Wen lives in this remote place and does not understand the changes in the outside world. He also does not know that Jiang Bei has just broken through to the Emperor of Gods.

If he knew, he would not react like this.

At this time, Yu Qingfeng said again: "Teacher, there is another person to introduce."

Hearing this, Kong Wen looked at Lu Daosheng, who had been smiling and silent.

His feeling told him that this was the most terrifying existence in the scene.

Even if his aura did not leak out.

At this time, Yu Qingfeng was about to speak, but Lu Daosheng waved his hand.

"Don't say so much, time is running out, let's hurry up."

Hearing this, Yu Qingfeng was stunned for a moment, and then he reacted immediately.

It seems that the senior doesn't want to expose his identity too much.

Yu Qingfeng thought so in his heart, and then hurriedly said: "Teacher, I will introduce you next time, let's hurry up to resurrect Luo Li."

Hearing this, Kong Wen was shocked.

Even now he can't believe that anyone can resurrect the dead.

What's more, Luo Li has been dead for tens of millions of years.

To put it bluntly, there are probably no bones left.

But Kong Wen did not question it, but followed Lu Daosheng and the other two to the back mountain.

The back mountain.

There are weeds and wild flowers here, which looks a little desolate.

In the center, there stands a lonely tombstone.

But the surroundings of the tombstone were extremely clean, and it was obvious that someone often came to clean it.

The four people walked to the tombstone, only to see that the words on the tombstone had become blurred due to years of wiping, and only the two words "Luo Li" could be vaguely seen.

"Luo Li, I'm back."

Yu Qingfeng stood in front of the tombstone, already in tears.

When Luo Li died, he completely gave up on cultivation and never made any progress since then.

In his heart, cultivation is not for the pursuit of immortality or the ultimate way, but for protecting the people he wants to protect.

But the person he wants to protect the most is already dead, so what is the point of his cultivation.

Looking at Yu Qingfeng, who was crying in front of them, Jiang Bei and Kong Wen were silent, and then looked at Lu Daosheng.

At this time, Lu Daosheng also had a complicated heart.

Is this love?

"System, are you really sure?"

Lu Daosheng asked in his heart.

In fact, if he worked harder, he could do it, but it would be very troublesome.

So he decided to let the system do it for him.

If the system doesn't work, he will do it himself.

[Host, please allow the system to be arrogant. There is nothing in this world that this system can't do]

After all, this system is already against the sky.

It seems not worth mentioning in front of resurrecting a living being.

After hearing the system's answer, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled.

In this case, it's easy to say.

"Get out of the way."

At this time, Lu Daosheng said lightly.

After hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Yu Qingfeng and the other two did not hesitate and quickly retreated to the distance.

In front of the tombstone, only Lu Daosheng was left.

In the distance, the three looked at Lu Daosheng, and they were all very nervous at this moment.

After all, resurrection from the dead is really incredible.

"System, leave it to you."

[Okay, host, please stretch out your right hand]

Then, Lu Daosheng slowly stretched out his right hand.

The next moment, an indescribable force suddenly spread out from Lu Daosheng's right hand.

Buzz——

Suddenly, the space in front of him began to fluctuate.

I saw that the entire tombstone, including the place behind it, began to change.

The tombstone became visibly brighter, the words on it gradually became clearer, and the place behind the tombstone began to bulge gradually.

Time goes back!

And it is permanent, not a short-term time go back.

In the distance, Yu Qingfeng and the other two were stunned when they saw this operation.

This method is really unheard of.

After reacting, Yu Qingfeng immediately became excited.

Seeing this, Kong Wen on the side hurriedly patted Yu Qingfeng on the shoulder.

"Qingfeng, don't get excited first."

But when he said this, his voice was trembling.

God still favors him.

At this time, in front of the tombstone, Lu Daosheng's expression was also slightly bright.

This system is really a good method.

Now the whole tomb is obviously close to the appearance when it was just buried.

However, at this moment, the entire space suddenly began to rumble.

The next moment, a roar filled with terror suddenly sounded.

"How dare you disrupt the order of time and space!!"

Boom!

A force containing the power of time and space flew out of the void and headed straight for Lu Daosheng.

Seeing that force, Yu Qingfeng and the other two turned pale.

What a terrifying force!

"Senior, be careful!"

Jiang Bei was the fastest and punched directly at the power of time and space.

However, when the fist light collided with the force of time and space, the force of time and space actually assimilated his attack directly.

"What?!"

Jiang Bei was shocked, watching the force of time and space about to hit Lu Daosheng.

Jiang Bei had no time to think, and immediately stood behind Lu Daosheng.

Sensing the force, Lu Daosheng raised his eyebrows slightly, and just flicked his left hand, and the force of time and space immediately dissipated into the void.

Seeing this scene, Yu Qingfeng and Kong Wen's eyelids jumped.

The senior's strength is really invincible.

And Jiang Bei's face was a little embarrassed, it seems that he is a little redundant.

"Huh?"

At this time, a questioning voice sounded from the void.

The next moment, a huge shadow of a long river of time and space suddenly emerged from the void and rolled towards here.

Seeing this huge long river of time and space, Yu Qingfeng and the other two were shocked.

What a terrifying breath of time and space, who is this strong man? !

At this time, Jiang Bei suddenly shouted: "Look, there is someone up there!"

The two looked over and saw that there was actually a shadow on the long river of time and space, stepping on the long river of time and space and walking slowly towards here.

"I didn't expect that there would be someone as powerful as you here, but you must pay the price for disrupting the order of time and space."

An extremely cold voice came from the long river of time and space.

Suddenly, an unimaginable breath of terror surged out from the shadow.

Feeling this breath, Yu Qingfeng and Kong Wen looked ugly, and even Jiang Bei, who had broken through to the God Emperor realm, felt a strong pressure.

So strong!

"Who are you?"

Looking at the shadow on the long river of time and space, Jiang Bei said in a deep voice.

Hearing this, a disdainful voice sounded from the long river of time and space.

"You are not qualified to know my identity."

Hearing this arrogant remark, Jiang Bei was stunned for a moment, then laughed: "Really? Then I really want to see what you have the capital to be so arrogant."

Then, Jiang Bei was about to take action.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's voice suddenly sounded.

"Jiang Bei, step back."
